decisions.reason: Its continued standalone presence and positive agency-focused feedback suggest performance at least near aspiration, and its compliance fit makes it worth retaining.
Its home-page prominence across both years indicates it performs above the firm's aspiration for strategic new offers and supports the core hosting platform.
It remained marketed on its own page in both years and is closely tied to the established hosting business, so there is no clear shortfall that would justify redeploying resources.

Although evidence is still limited after its 2024 launch, it is highly adjacent to the firm's security-focused core offer and, with industry growth and likely slack, should be kept for further learning.
